task.title: Analyze Orders payment calculation without modifying code
task.description: Read-only smoke workflow for context routing, compact dependency summaries, repository mapping, telemetry and safe tool fallbacks.

nodes.title: Plan the payment calculation analysis
nodes.description: Locate the existing Orders payment calculation boundaries and split read-only investigation without proposing code changes.
acceptance_criteria: Identify exact frontend backend and database boundaries

nodes.title: Inspect frontend payment projection
nodes.description: Use targeted symbols and references to explain how Orders renders payment totals and status.
acceptance_criteria: Do not read unrelated backend history

nodes.title: Inspect backend payment calculation
nodes.description: Use targeted symbols and references to trace payment totals deposit threshold and production-slot effects.

nodes.title: Inspect payment persistence
nodes.description: Use targeted model lookup to map Order Payment and ProductionSlot relations relevant to payment calculation.
acceptance_criteria: Report only relevant models and invariants

nodes.title: Consolidate payment calculation analysis
nodes.description: Produce a compact report from dependency summaries and distinguish verified source facts from remaining runtime evidence gaps.
acceptance_criteria: Use dependency summaries rather than transcripts
